prerequisites: Mathematics skills (especially vector and matrix calculus)

learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully studied this module have a basic knowledge of image data representation, know the procedure for extracting information, and know basic image processing algorithms.
Students know the steps of image processing from pixel representation to the extraction of knowledge from images using selected algorithms.
Students are able to implement simple image processing algorithms in programs and combine them. Thus, they can practically solve simple image processing tasks.

syllabus_topics: Image enhancement in the spatial domain
assessment_rules: Graded assessment can be a written exam, a written project report (approx. 10-15 pages with approx. 20 minutes explanation), or an oral examination. Ungraded assessment consists of experimental work, involving approximately 5 experiments in total.
